In the lower middle distance, a SMALL low fire burns on the stone floor among a few broken plain wooden bench planks and dismantled plain furniture timber, with a thin thread of smoke. Keep flame height low, subdued and believable; this is a restrained warmth-seeking camp fire, not a destructive building fire. Much of the church remains empty. Worn snow and slush at the entrance threshold in the foreground.
People: only TWO SMALL anonymous fictional adult soldiers far inside the nave, wearing plain worn dark blue early-1800s long military coats, dark trousers and simple dark caps with no insignia. Both entirely seen from behind, looking away; each no more than about one tenth of image height. No face visible, no historical person likeness, no Napoleon. No weapons.
Composition: wide full-frame view with both the brick vaults and storage sacks/barrels clearly legible. Fire and supplies remain discernible when the whole image is reduced to 480 pixels wide. Natural spatial scale and perspective, no cropped foreground human figures.
Style/medium: convincing camera-captured natural-material reconstruction, tactile irregular masonry, coarse woven sacks, aged timber and muddy snow, photographic texture without painterly brushwork or glossy CGI.
Lighting/mood: cold soft winter daylight from narrow windows, balanced with a gentle local warm glow from the small fire, restrained gray-blue and brick-brown palette. Naturally dim but readable exposure, no theatrical spotlight or volumetric beams. No HDR, cinematic grading, oversaturation or disaster spectacle.

The wolf's entire body, all four legs, paws, tail and raised head must be visible against the night sky. It has realistic wolf anatomy with worn dark iron and steel-gray surface texture that follows the fur; restrained moonlit metal highlights. No cartoon eyes, giant monster or glossy robotic joints.
Scene/backdrop: a forested Lithuanian river valley evoking the Neris and Vilnia landscape in the early 1300s legendary world. From the valley look gently upward toward the nearby hill. Behind and around the hillside, two gently curving river reaches can be discerned through trees. The full moon behind the wolf is softly bright and realistic in scale. The summit has grass and natural rock only, NO castle, fort, tower, buildings or modern city.
Human detail: at the lower base of the hill, a tiny fire and THREE very small adult campers sleeping nearby in plain muted rough wool cloaks, simple tunics and leather boots, suggesting an anonymous medieval hunting party. The sleeping adults have backs turned or heads fully covered/turned away under cloaks; no visible face. One lies a little nearer the camera, but still tiny and subordinate to the hill and wolf. No actual Gediminas likeness, no crown, heraldry, portrait or weapons. Peaceful sleepers, clearly alive and resting, no injury.
Composition: wide landscape observed from low on the river valley edge, hill and whole howling wolf form the clear principal subject in the upper middle distance, tiny campfire and sleeping party at the lower hillside, rivers and trees extending naturally across the scene. Keep the entire wolf inside the frame. Clear silhouette that stays legible in a full-frame 480px-wide preview. Spatially plausible, original arrangement, no imitation of a specific existing painting or sculpture.
Style/medium: natural photograph-like reconstruction with real grass, damp soil, bark, forest foliage, rough wool, worn iron texture and believable atmosphere. A photorealistic material world containing a legendary wolf; no painterly/romantic historical painting style, brushwork, art reproduction, fantasy poster or glossy CGI render.
Lighting/mood: muted natural moonlight with the small local orange fire glow, naturally dim but readable blue-gray forest and neutral gray wolf. Soft moonlit contours, believable dark sky, no enormous halo, HDR, cinematic grading, oversaturated colors or theatrical shafts of light.
Avoid: all words, letters, numerals, labels, signs, logos, inscriptions, watermarks, captions, picture frame/border; visible or recognizable human faces, historical or living person likeness; Gediminas Tower or any castle/settlement/building; actual museum collection replicas; copied painting composition; weapons, modern objects, blood, injury, violence or bodies.
